I reviewed `1fb2fdc1…HEAD`, but not with the full pipeline. There were no parallel category agents and no validator/refuter pairs. I ran the nine passes myself and checked each finding against the code. Because nothing was adjudicated, **this review has no score** and should be treated as a thorough draft. No files were changed, no tests were run, and nothing was posted.

**Scope:** 4 files, +220 −63. The three-dot diff compares against merge-base `cd3b9fa`, not `1fb2fdc`, and ends at `3a6eb47` (working tree not included).

## Summary

| | |
|---|---|
| Verdict | **Fix the first finding before opening the PR.** The rest are small. |
| Fix first | The spinner replaces an already-loaded spaces list whenever the list reloads in the background. |
| Areas with nothing found | Security, regression, performance, DRY, architecture |

## Must fix

**1 · A loaded spaces list turns into a spinner on every background reload** — bugs, P2 · `apps/web/src/features/spaces/components/SpacesList/index.tsx:245`

- **What:** The new spinner condition is `isUserSignedIn && isSpacesLoading`, and `isSpacesLoading` includes `isFetching` (line 210). RTK Query sets `isFetching` on every refetch, even when `currentData` is still cached.
- **When it happens:** A user declines an invite from the banner on this page. `membersDeclineInviteV1` invalidates the `spaces` tag (`packages/store/src/gateway/AUTO_GENERATED/spaces.ts:154`), so the list refetches. While it does, the whole list and all invite banners are replaced by a spinner, then they come back. The same happens for any other `spaces` invalidation while the page is open. It probably also happens when `useFlowActivationGuard` fires `fetchSpaces()` on navigation (`useFlowActivationGuard.ts:111`), but I didn't confirm that it runs on this route.
- **Why it matters:** It undoes the aim of commit 4bb5a6c ("keep showing the spaces list if it was cached"). That commit only covers the error case, not the refetch case.
- **Fix:** Show the spinner only when there is no data yet, for example `!isStoreHydrated || (isUserSignedIn && spaces === undefined && isSpacesLoading)`. Keep passing the full `isSpacesLoading` to `useSignInRedirect`, whose redirect guard needs it.
- **Test to add:** Mock `{ currentData: [activeSpace], isFetching: true }` and assert that `space-row` renders and the spinner does not. Right now no test covers this state.

## Worth a ticket / your call

| # | Area | Location | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | testing, P3 | `SpacesList.test.tsx:180-190` | The "12px spacing" test checks the CSS classes `.gap-3` / `gap-1.5`, and the `data-size="none"` test at `:169` checks a styling prop. These break on any restyle but miss visual regressions. A Storybook story is the repo's tool for visual states (`apps/web/AGENTS.md:149-150`). The `not.toHaveClass('gap-1.5')` line adds almost nothing, because the element was found by `.gap-3`. |
| 3 | testing, P3 | `SpacesList.test.tsx` | The new loading and error branches have no story, so the retry UI and spinner are only covered by DOM tests. |
| 4 | conventions, P3 | `SpacesList/index.tsx:133` | `WORKSPACE_BENEFITS` is exported from the component module only so the test can read `[0]`. The test could match the literal text (`'Organize multiple Safe accounts in one place'`) and the constant could stay private. |
| 5 | KISS, P3 | `SpacesList/index.tsx:245-288` | The JSX is now a five-branch nested ternary (spinner, signed out, error, list, empty). Pulling it into a small helper or early returns would make the order of the conditions easier to read. Optional. |

## Not sure about these (not filed)

- **Expired session shown as "contact support":** a 401 from `/v1/spaces` while `sessionExpiresAt` is still in the future now shows "Couldn't load your workspaces… contact support" (`index.tsx:251`). Before, it fell through to the empty state. The new copy is arguably better than the old behavior, but a re-sign-in prompt might fit a 401 better. This is a product call.
- **Test comment says "two" selectors:** the `setAuth` comment (`SpacesList.test.tsx:96-98`) says the component reads two auth selectors. `useSignInRedirect` reads a third, but it's mocked here, so the comment is accurate for this test.

## Ruled out

- **Spinner stuck forever before hydration:** can't happen. `useHydrateStore` always dispatches `@@HYDRATE`, even with no persisted state, and the reducer sets `isStoreHydrated: true` (`store/index.ts:170-175`).
- **Receive icon swap (`ArrowDownLeft` → `QrCode`):** no test or snapshot references the old icon in `ActionsTray` or `HeaderActions`. `ArrowDownLeft` is still used elsewhere for incoming transactions (`useTransactionType.tsx:80`), which is correct.
- **Card `size="none"` refactor:** the Card docs list `'none'` as a size, and padding moved to an inner div. That removes the `eslint-disable` and follows the rule "`className` is layout-only".

## Not covered

- Tests, lint and type-check were not run, as you asked.
- There was no browser check of the layout change.
- There were no leave-it-better cleanup proposals.
